data.name: SkyMine
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the World of Mining!

Start digging, discover valuable resources, and uncover the secrets of surviving among the mines. This game combines strategy and creativity, offering an exciting experience. From stone to diamond, from rare minerals to energy-producing elements—collect countless resources, grow rich, and build your empire!

Key Features:

  • In-Depth Mining System: Discover stone, copper, gold, diamond, and more. Each resource has unique value, weight, and applications!

  • Resource Management: Process the materials you gather, trade them, and shape your future.

  • Energy Production and Development: Harness energy sources like lithium to advance your technology and produce more efficient tools.

  • Create Your Own Strategy: Choose your resources wisely and manage your upgrades carefully to maximize profits.

Mining is just the beginning!
Trade the resources you collect to grow your wealth or spark an industrial revolution with technological advancements. Whether you're looking for a relaxing simulation or a deep strategy game, this is the perfect experience for you!

Are you ready?
Grab your pickaxe and embark on a journey into the unknown riches of the underground!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB
  • Storage: 4096 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB
